name: Lindy
shortDescription: Assistant for inbox and calendar jobs, with $50 in free credits.
longDescription: Lindy's pricing page says you can start with $50 in free credits and lists jobs including inbox and calendar, scheduling, and lead outreach. It also lists credit packs from $29.99. We did not create an account, and we do not treat the credit pack as a flat monthly seat price.
pricingNotes: The pricing page offers $50 in free credits and lists inbox and calendar among jobs. Credit packs are listed from $29.99, which is not a confirmed seat subscription.
bestFor: Handing inbox and calendar chores to an assistant that bills in credits
notIdealFor: Someone who wants one flat seat price with credits included
strength: Lindy's pricing page offers $50 in free credits and lists inbox and calendar among the jobs it can take.
weakness: Paid use is sold as credit packs, starting at $29.99 on that page, not as one flat seat subscription we could confirm.
smokeTestNotes: Official page checked on 2026-10-19. No account, payment, or hands-on run.

useCaseFit.scheduling-assistant: Lists inbox and calendar work and starts with $50 in free credits.
